subject: simulate multiple group CFA data with covariate

messages.author: d6a8445c249b2e43
messages.subject: simulate multiple group CFA data with covariate
parts:
Hello,

My goal is to generate x1-x6 in two groups.X1-X6 is predicted by one latent factor (factor), covariate (cov) can also predict x1-x6.
Now the latent factor (factor), group, and one covariate(cov) were already generated.  I don't know whether Lavaan can combine these three already generated variables(i.e., factor, group, cov) altogether. Here is my code:



require(lavaan)
var_f<-0.5               #factor(f) is already generated , so variance in each group is known
var_group<- c(0.6,0.4)
cov<-data$cov        #covariate is already generated
group<-data$group

cfa_popmodel<-'f=~0.7 * x1 + 0.8 * x2 + 0.6 * x3 + 0.5 * x4 + 0.4 * x5 + 0.3 * x6 
f~~ var_f * f           # variance of f is 0.5
f~(var_group)*1      #variance of f in Group 1 is 0.6, varaiance of f in Group 2 is 0.4
x1~c(0.1,0.2)*1      #tao- intercept of X1 in Group1 is 0.1, intercept of x1 in Group 2 is 0.2
x2~c(0.2,0.3)*1  
x3~c(0.3,0.4)*1  
x4~c(0.4,0.5)*1  
x5~c(0.5,0.6)*1  
x6~c(0.6,0.7)*1 

x1~(0.5,0.4)*cov    #path coefficinet from cov to x1 in two groups
x2~(0.5,0.4)*cov
x3~(0.5,0.4)*cov
x4~(0.5,0.4)*cov
x5~(0.5,0.4)*cov
x6~(0.5,0.4)*cov
' 


simdata<-simulateData(model=cfa_popmodel, sample.nobs = c(250L, 250L),model.type = "cfa")  
summary(simdata)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: simulate multiple group CFA data with covariate
parts:
I don't know why you need to generate the covariate in a separate step, but if you can't specify it in as a variable (to be generated) in your model syntax, then it can't be part of that system of variables you are generating. 

If you need that covariate as-is for some reason, then you can just generate common factor scores, unique factor scores, and the grouping variable separately as well.  Then use all those variables "as-is" along with the covariate to create the linear combinations called x1-x6.  Check out an example of generating from the data model in a previous thread:

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lavaan/PxFUKcIwPd0/-T67JNWL4doJ

messages.subject: Re: simulate multiple group CFA data with covariate
parts: Since I will generate multiple group CFA data, do you have any similar example to generate multiple group data (i.e., different unique factor score, factor loading between two groups)?

Use a path diagram of your model as a template.  Any variable is a sum of whatever other variables point to it, each weighted by the coefficient of that path.  If you have multiple groups with distinct parameters, then just generate data for each group separately and stack them using rbind() afterward.
